headline: Continental Securities completes dividend payout
summary: Continental Securities Ltd distributed dividends on October 14, 2026, to shareholders recorded as of September 21, 2026, via electronic transfer.

headline: AXISCADES sets up space tech subsidiary
summary: AXISCADES Technologies incorporates Xponential Space Private Limited to design satellites and provide space solutions. The wholly owned subsidiary begins with ₹1 lakh capital.

headline: Rashi Peripherals auditor Deloitte ceases role
summary: Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP ceased as statutory auditor of Rashi Peripherals due to ineligibility under Companies Act, 2013 following an acquisition.

headline: Ixigo Q2FY27 PAT jumps to ₹63.42 crore
summary: Ixigo reported a net profit of ₹63.42 crore for Q2FY27, driven by a one-time gain from selling Freshbus shares. Revenue rose 12.9% YoY to ₹320.96 crore.

headline: Omaxe gets RERA nod for Eternity-2 project in Mathura
summary: Omaxe has received RERA approval for its commercial and service apartment project Eternity-2 in Mathura, marking a key regulatory milestone for the development.

headline: LCC Infotech appoints Ronak Thakor as executive director
summary: LCC Infotech Limited appointed Ronak Thakor as Additional Director (Executive) effective October 17, 2026. The appointment follows a board meeting held on the same date under SEBI regulations.

headline: Western Overseas expands global outreach via fairs
summary: Western Overseas Study Abroad Ltd expands global outreach through multi-city education fairs, Indo-Russia Talent Bridge, and overseas recruitment drives in Dubai.

headline: Chambal Fertilisers acquires 26% stake in Clean Max Hachi
summary: Chambal Fertilisers & Chemicals Ltd to invest up to ₹6 crore for a 26% stake in Clean Max Hachi Private Limited, a captive power SPV in Rajasthan.

headline: Refex Industries wins ₹32.45 crore ash transport deal
summary: Refex Industries has secured a ₹32.45 crore ash transportation contract from a Maharatna PSU under the Ministry of Power, marking a significant order win.

headline: TVS Srichakra to expand capacity with ₹49.20 crore capex
summary: TVS Srichakra Limited approved ₹49.20 crore capital expenditure for line balancing and debottlenecking at Madurai and Uttarakhand plants, aiming for 6-7% capacity addition.

headline: Indo Cotspin Q2FY27 PAT jumps 880% YoY
summary: Indo Cotspin Limited reported a sharp rise in net profit to ₹9.02 lakh for Q2FY27, up from ₹0.92 lakh YoY, despite a significant decline in operational revenue.

headline: Krishna Filament posts FY26 loss of ₹0.35 lakh
summary: Krishna Filament Industries reported a loss before tax of ₹0.35 lakh in FY26, reversing from a profit. The company had no operational revenue, relying solely on agricultural income.

headline: Maithan Alloys acquires 0.04% stake in Sterlite Tech
summary: Maithan Alloys acquired 228,000 shares of Sterlite Technologies for ₹19.97 crore on October 16, 2026. The move is a passive investment with no intent to control.

headline: Amrish Vinod Mehta acquires 5.76% stake in Omara Ventures
summary: Amrish Vinod Mehta and PACs acquired 2,51,200 equity shares of Omara Ventures India Ltd via open market, raising holding to 5.76%.

headline: Yes Bank reschedules Q2FY27 analyst call to Oct 17
summary: Yes Bank Ltd has rescheduled its conference call for Q2FY27 financial results to Saturday, October 17, 2026, at 4:00 pm IST. The session will feature MD & CEO Vinay M. Tonse.

headline: Axis Bank Q2FY27 Net Profit Rises 37.6% YoY
summary: Axis Bank reported a standalone net profit of ₹7,003.28 crore for Q2FY27, up 37.6% YoY. Gross NPAs improved to 1.16%, while capital adequacy stood at 16.27%.

headline: SPML Infra wins Fastest Growing Construction Award
summary: SPML Infra Limited was honoured as the 'Fastest Growing Construction Company' at the Construction World Global Awards 2026 in Mumbai.

headline: Garware Hi-Tech Films to host analyst meet on Oct 22
summary: Garware Hi-Tech Films Limited will hold a one-on-one meeting with Mahindra Manulife Mutual Fund on October 22, 2026, at its Mumbai corporate office.

headline: Trustedge Capital CFO resigns effective Oct 17, 2026
summary: Jayprakash Labhshankar Raval resigned as Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel of Trustedge Capital due to personal reasons.

headline: Central Bank of India Q2FY27 Results
summary: Central Bank of India reported a 21% YoY rise in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹1,468.86 crore. Net interest income grew 18.4% YoY, while asset quality improved with GNPA at 2.39%.

headline: Monarch Surveyors wins ₹51.20 crore Southern Railway order
summary: Monarch Surveyors & Engg. Consultants has secured a ₹51.20 crore order from Southern Railway for surveys and detailed project reports (DPRs).

headline: Supreme Court vacates status quo on MosChip-Vayavya dispute
summary: MosChip Technologies confirms the Supreme Court has vacated the status quo order regarding the Vayavya Labs acquisition. The move follows a ₹200 crore security deposit by the judgment debtor, with no operational impact on MosChip.

headline: RailTel secures ₹18.99 crore IT order
summary: RailTel Corporation of India won a ₹18.99 crore order for IT infrastructure and cybersecurity from Health Insurance TPA of India, strengthening its digital portfolio.

headline: HDFC Bank Q2 net profit rises 4.7% YoY
summary: HDFC Bank reported Q2 net profit of ₹195.1 billion, up from ₹186.4 billion YoY. Revenue grew to ₹834.3 billion. Asset quality improved with GNPA at 1.11%.

headline: Knack Packaging SMP Rahul Adesara resigns
summary: Knack Packaging Limited announced the resignation of Rahul Jagdishbhai Adesara, Manager - Costing & Analysis and Senior Management Personnel, effective October 17, 2026.

headline: Kirloskar Ferrous resumes Hiriyr plant operations
summary: Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Ltd has resumed operations at the Mini Blast Furnace of its Hiriyr plant in Karnataka as of October 16, 2026.

headline: Borosil Renewables faces ₹60 lakh customs penalty
summary: Borosil Renewables received a customs order imposing a ₹30 lakh penalty and ₹30 lakh redemption fine for tariff classification errors on solar glass machinery.

headline: Axis Bank appoints Rahul Shukla as Group Head
summary: Axis Bank appoints Rahul Shukla as Group Head, Commercial and Bharat Banking, effective October 19, 2026. He joins from HDFC Bank to lead growth.

headline: Sangam shareholders approve Jagetia as Independent Director
summary: Sangam (India) Ltd shareholders approved the appointment of Ranjan Jagetia as Independent Director via postal ballot with 99.99% votes in favour.

headline: IDBI Bank Q2 net profit falls to ₹22 billion
summary: IDBI Bank reported a standalone net profit of ₹22 billion in Q2, down from ₹36.3 billion YoY. Gross NPA improved to 2.12%, while net NPA rose slightly.

headline: Acutaas Chemicals completes acquisition of Enchem Ami Organics
summary: Acutaas Chemicals Limited completed the acquisition of 100% equity in Enchem Ami Organics Private Limited on October 17, 2026, making it a direct wholly owned subsidiary.

headline: Shalby resumes Jabalpur hospital ops
summary: Shalby Ltd confirmed the resumption of normal operations at its Jabalpur hospital following the withdrawal of registration suspension by local authorities.

headline: Gagan Gases Q2FY27: Profit turns positive
summary: Gagan Gases reported a net profit of ₹1.88 lakh in Q2FY27, reversing a loss from the prior year. Revenue fell 57% YoY to ₹70.46 lakh, while H1 profit reached ₹5.81 lakh.

headline: Darshan P Desai HUF sells 5.45 lakh shares of BN Rathi
summary: Darshan P Desai HUF sold 545,163 equity shares of BN Rathi Securities via open market. Post-sale holding stands at 4.11%. Disclosure filed late on October 16, 2026.

headline: ICICI Bank Q2FY27 PAT rises 20.1% to ₹14,843 crore
summary: ICICI Bank reported a 20.1% YoY rise in standalone PAT to ₹14,843 crore for Q2FY27, driven by strong credit growth and improved asset quality.

headline: South Indian Bank hikes MCLR rates
summary: South Indian Bank revised its Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rates across multiple tenors effective October 20, 2026. The one-year MCLR stands at 9.50%.

headline: MCX incorporates mineral exchange subsidiary
summary: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd has incorporated MCX Mineral Exchange of India Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary on October 16, 2026.

headline: Quality Power subsidiary starts PCS facility in Türkiye
summary: Quality Power Electrical Equipments' subsidiary Endoks Energy Systems commenced manufacturing at its new PCS facility in Niğde, Türkiye on October 16, 2026.

headline: HDFC Bank board approves Lily Vadera re-appointment
summary: HDFC Bank board approved the re-appointment of Lily Vadera as Independent Director for three years and accepted Kaizad Bharucha's cessation request.

headline: Nicco Parks shareholders approve two director appointments
summary: Nicco Parks & Resorts Limited shareholders passed two ordinary resolutions via postal ballot to appoint Soumitra Sankar Sengupta and Shiv Siddhant Narayan Kaul as directors.

headline: United Textiles seeks promoter reclassification
summary: United Textiles Ltd received requests from 18 promoter group members to move to public category. Board will consider on November 13, 2026.

headline: Godawari Power sets up energy subsidiary
summary: Godawari Power & Ispat Ltd has incorporated Godawari Energy Solutions Private Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary to undertake EPC and renewable energy projects.

headline: Sarda Energy to set up wholly owned Dubai subsidiary
summary: Sarda Energy & Minerals board approved creation of a wholly owned subsidiary in Dubai with an initial investment of up to ₹3 crore to expand business in the Middle East.

headline: Shree Karthik Papers confirms nil promoter encumbrance
summary: Shree Karthik Papers Limited confirmed no encumbrance on promoter shares for Q2FY27. Promoters hold 74.52% equity with zero pledged shares as of September 30, 2026.

headline: Ajwa Fun World Secretarial Auditor Resigns
summary: M/s. V. N. Vasani & Associates resigned as Secretarial Auditor of Ajwa Fun World & Resort Ltd effective October 17, 2026, citing pre-occupation.

headline: Gravita India invests ₹94.42 crore in subsidiary RMIL
summary: Gravita India approved an additional investment of ₹94.42 crore to subscribe to the rights issue of material subsidiary Rashtriya Metal Industries Limited.

headline: Amber appoints Satendra Singh as CEO of IL JIN
summary: Amber Enterprises appointed Satendra Singh as CEO and Whole-Time Director of material subsidiary IL JIN Electronics for a five-year term, replacing Sanjay Kumar Arora.

headline: Bajaj Finserv incorporates reinsurance subsidiary
summary: Bajaj Finserv Limited incorporated Bajaj Reinsurance Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary on October 17, 2026. The entity is formed to carry on reinsurance business, subject to regulatory approvals.

headline: Bajaj Healthcare Q2FY27 PAT rises 27% YoY
summary: Bajaj Healthcare reported a 26.8% YoY rise in net profit to ₹14.1 crore for Q2FY27. Revenue grew 18.9% to ₹17.6 crore, driven by strong demand in formulations and APIs.

headline: Voith Paper Fabrics approves new MD appointment
summary: Voith Paper Fabrics India Ltd shareholders approved the appointment of Asesh Kumar Mukherjee as Managing Director via postal ballot. The resolution passed with 99.9995% votes in favour.

headline: Sambhv Steel allots 86.95 lakh warrants at ₹115
summary: Sambhv Steel Tubes allotted 8,695,400 fully convertible equity warrants at ₹115 each on a preferential basis. Promoter group Anjaneya Minerals acquired the majority stake.

headline: MOIL details JV with MP State Mining Corp
summary: MOIL Limited submits consolidated details on its joint venture, MOIL MPSMCL Mining Limited. The entity holds 51% stake in the manganese ore mining venture.

headline: Lincoln Pharma senior QA head resigns
summary: Lincoln Pharmaceuticals Ltd announced the resignation of Pradeep Kumar Yadav, Senior General Manager of Quality Assurance, effective October 17, 2026, citing personal reasons.

headline: India Cements Q2FY27 PAT jumps 160% to ₹38.85 crore
summary: India Cements reported a 160% YoY rise in standalone net profit for Q2FY27, driven by margin expansion and reduced freight costs.

headline: Indo Amines gets conditional nod to restart Mahad ops
summary: Indo Amines has received conditional approval to resume operations at its Mahad facility, excluding TBU production, subject to compliance with MPCB regulations.

headline: Zodiac Energy wins Gujarat HC case on GST demand
summary: The High Court of Gujarat quashed a GST show cause notice for FY19 against Zodiac Energy. The court set aside the demand and penalties, stating no impact on operations.

headline: CLN Energy discloses Singapore legal case against Chairman
summary: CLN Energy Limited disclosed legal proceedings in Singapore against Chairman Rajiv Seth in his personal capacity. The company stated the dispute involves no company assets.

headline: TGB Banquets Q2FY27 profit falls 52% YoY
summary: TGB Banquets & Hotels reported a 52% YoY decline in net profit to ₹9.90 lakh for Q2FY27. Revenue from operations dropped 37% YoY to ₹542.22 lakh.

headline: BF Utilities postal ballot for director appointment
summary: BF Utilities concludes e-voting for Ajay Charuchandra Kirtane's appointment as Independent Director. Results to be declared by October 21, 2026.

headline: KPI Green subsidiary lifts DMGEL stake to 88.37%
summary: Sun Drops Energia, a material subsidiary of KPI Green Energy, acquired additional shares in DMGEL, raising its total holding to 88.37% of the paid-up equity capital.

headline: Grand Oak Canyons CS resigns effective Oct 17
summary: Sarvagya Goel resigned as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of Grand Oak Canyons Distillery due to personal reasons, effective October 17, 2026.

headline: Arvaya Healthcare to consider share allotment
summary: Arvaya Healthcare Limited board meets Oct 24, 2026, to approve preferential allotment of 38.7 lakh shares to SIGPL shareholders for non-cash consideration.

headline: Hindustan Zinc shareholders approve CEO and director appointments
summary: Hindustan Zinc shareholders passed resolutions appointing Amarendu Prakash as CEO and Yogesh Attray as Independent Director via postal ballot with strong majority support.

headline: VVIP Infratech board to meet Oct 22 on preferential issue
summary: VVIP Infratech Limited's board will convene on October 22, 2026, to consider raising funds via preferential issuance of equity shares or warrants. The meeting follows SEBI regulations and occurs during a closed trading window.

headline: Ausom Enterprise appoints Shivani Pathak as CS
summary: Ausom Enterprise Limited appointed Ms. Shivani Rajeshbhai Pathak as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective October 17, 2026.

headline: Divyashakti cuts production amid cost surge
summary: Divyashakti Ltd reduces production from Sept 29, 2026, due to 41% US tariffs and rising input costs. Resin prices jumped 72% as crude oil hit $108 per barrel.

headline: Master Trust subsidiary starts F&O clearing
summary: Master Capital Services Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of Master Trust Ltd, commenced clearing and settlement services in the F&O segment of NSE and BSE on October 15, 2026.

headline: Bright Outdoor Media expands Mumbai network
summary: Bright Outdoor Media Limited adds 22 new sites and 104 displays in Mumbai MMR, boosting ad space by 53,898 sq ft. The expansion strengthens its OOH presence and digital LED capabilities.

headline: Maithan Alloys sets up water EPC subsidiary
summary: Maithan Alloys incorporated M&M Water Solutions Private Limited with an 80% stake for ₹4 crore to enter water treatment and sewage plant EPC projects.

headline: Punjab & Sind Bank Q2FY27 net profit rises 40% YoY
summary: Punjab & Sind Bank reported a 40% year-on-year rise in net profit to ₹412 crore for Q2FY27, driven by strong interest income and reduced provisions.

headline: Bhandari Hosiery CS resigns effective Oct 17, 2026
summary: Bhandari Hosiery Exports Limited confirmed the resignation of Shilpa Tiwari as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The departure is effective October 17, 2026, due to personal reasons.

headline: Alembic Pharma gets USFDA nod for ear infection drug
summary: Alembic Pharmaceuticals received final USFDA approval for Ciprofloxacin and Dexamethasone Otic Suspension. The generic targets a $110 million market, bringing its total ANDA approvals to 246.

headline: Nureca Ltd closes DRI customs case
summary: Nureca Limited received closure of DRI proceedings regarding product classification. A pre-deposit of ₹57.13 lakh was appropriated as duty and interest, discharging liabilities.

headline: Hemo Organic Q2FY27: Turns profitable, auditor flags receivables
summary: Hemo Organic Limited reported a net profit of ₹0.53 lakh in Q2FY27, turning around from a loss. However, the statutory auditor issued a qualified opinion citing missing balance confirmations for trade receivables and payables.

headline: Yes Bank Q2FY27: Supreme Court verdict looms over results
summary: Yes Bank reported a standalone net profit of ₹1,080 crore for Q2FY27. However, auditors issued a qualified opinion due to the Supreme Court's October 15, 2026 judgment upholding the Bombay High Court's decision on the ₹8,415 crore AT-1 bond write-down.

headline: Orissa HC rules in favor of JSW Cement on SGST claim
summary: JSW Cement Ltd received a favorable judgment from the Orissa High Court regarding SGST reimbursement under IPR 2015, overturning a retrospective exclusion.

headline: Rossari Biotech Q2FY27 Results: Revenue up 19% YoY
summary: Rossari Biotech reported a 19% YoY rise in consolidated revenue to ₹6,976 million for Q2FY27. The board also approved leasing land in Saudi Arabia for a new greenfield facility.

headline: Roto Pumps appoints Jörg Gertz as CSMO
summary: Roto Pumps appoints Jörg Gertz as Chief Sales and Marketing Officer to drive international growth. The move supports the company's 'Roto Next' mission targeting $100 million in sales by FY31.

headline: United Spirits faces DRI search ops
summary: United Spirits Limited disclosed that the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence initiated search operations at multiple locations on October 16, 2026. The company stated no financial or operational impact as of now.

headline: Yes Bank appoints Sai Venkataramana Kosuri as CVO
summary: Yes Bank appoints Sai Venkataramana Kosuri as Chief Vigilance Officer effective November 25, 2026. He succeeds interim CVO Harish Sehgal following Binu Soman's resignation.

headline: Tiaan Consumer CS Riya Jain resigns
summary: Tiaan Consumer Limited announced the resignation of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer Riya Jain effective October 17, 2026, citing personal reasons.

headline: Cupid Breweries Q2FY27: Zero revenue, loss widens
summary: Cupid Breweries reported zero revenue for Q2FY27. Standalone net loss widened to ₹17.21 lakh, while consolidated loss stood at ₹92.51 lakh as operations remain pre-commercial.

headline: Horizon Reclaim H1FY27 revenue up 28%
summary: Horizon Reclaim (India) Ltd reported H1FY27 revenue of ₹2,817.98 crore, marking a 28.24% YoY increase. The company also commissioned its Rajkot pyrolysis facility.

headline: Zen Technologies acquires Cogknit Semantics for ₹135.15 crore
summary: Zen Technologies Ltd board approved the acquisition of a 51.98% stake in Cogknit Semantics Private Limited for up to ₹135.15 crore, expanding its AI-based defence portfolio.

headline: Yes Bank appoints Kotak risk chief as independent director
summary: Yes Bank appoints Paul Verghese Parambi, former Kotak Mahindra Group CRO, as additional independent director for four years effective November 2026.

headline: Rare Earth Engineers board meet postponed to Oct 22
summary: Rare Earth Engineers Limited postponed its board meeting to October 22, 2026, to consider Q2FY27 results. The trading window remains closed until 48 hours post-disclosure.

headline: Karamtara Engineering to set up defence subsidiary
summary: Karamtara Engineering Ltd board approved the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary, Karamtara Defence & Aerospace Limited, in India on October 17, 2026.

headline: AceVector re-appoints Kasaragod Ullas Kamath
summary: AceVector Ltd re-appointed Kasaragod Ullas Kamath as Independent Director for a second five-year term effective October 18, 2026, subject to shareholder approval.

headline: Suryoday SFB board to meet on Oct 22 for NCD issue
summary: Suryoday Small Finance Bank Ltd will hold a board meeting on October 22, 2026, to consider raising funds via Tier II bonds through private placement.

headline: Antony Waste Q2FY27: Tonnage up 0.8%, PCMC WtE offline
summary: Antony Waste Handling Cell reported 0.8% YoY tonnage growth in Q2FY27 despite PCMC WtE suspension. C&T volumes rose 11.5%, offsetting processing declines.

headline: Imagicaaworld director Suresh Bharathwaj exits
summary: Suresh Bharathwaj ceased as Independent Director of Imagicaaworld Entertainment on October 17, 2026, after completing his second term.

headline: Juniper Green sets up two new renewable units
summary: Juniper Green Energy incorporated two wholly owned subsidiaries for renewable power projects. Total equity subscription stood at ₹30 lakh.
